issue_context.title: Snippet hoisting issue
issue_context.body:
### Describe the bug

With the following code:

```svelte
<script>
	let abc = 'a'
</script>

{@render b()}

{#snippet a()}
	{abc}
{/snippet}

{#snippet b()}
	{@render a()}
{/snippet}
```

We get the following error making the app unable to build:

`a is not defined` 

### Reproduction

[REPL](https://svelte.dev/playground/e222fce7b2fa4774bb57f351fd3b2898?version=5.10.0)

### Logs

_No response_

### System Info

```shell
REPL v5.10
```


### Severity

blocking an upgrade
comments: That's because `abc` is within the component `<script>`. Maybe we can improve the error messaging here though.

> That's because `abc` is within the component `<script>`. Maybe we can improve the error messaging here though.

The problem is that we shouldn't hoist `b` because it depends on `a` which depends on `abc`

review_comments: Why can we just partially undo the fix @dummdidumm did? Did something changed in the hoisting mechanism?
